description: MISSION-CRITICAL DATA EXTRACTION: Process archive of technical documents from multiple sources. Extract ALL data with maximum detail and accuracy. Generate premium-quality HTML reports with professional visualizations. Create master analytics dashboard. ZERO data loss tolerance - every field, every number, every event must be captured.

execution_preferences.task_organization: INTELLIGENT PATTERN DISCOVERY: System must auto-discover document types/patterns without hardcoded assumptions. Adapt to ANY structure. Batch process by discovered patterns. Emphasize QUALITY over speed.

data_extraction_requirements.schema_flexibility: Adapt schema to discovered document structure

required_fields.metadata: ALL header/title information (dates, names, identifiers, locations, equipment)
required_fields.financial_data: ALL costs, rates, budgets, expenditures with currency and breakdown
required_fields.events: EVERY recorded event with full details (type, time, description in original language AND English translation, duration, severity, impact, personnel, corrective actions)
required_fields.operations: COMPLETE operational logs (hourly activities, descriptions in original AND English, equipment, parameters, depths, times)
required_fields.tables: ALL tables extracted with headers and data (preserve structure)
required_fields.metrics: ALL numeric KPIs, measurements, totals, averages

data_extraction_requirements.translation_requirement: For ANY non-English content: Provide BOTH original text AND accurate English translation. Preserve technical terms.
data_extraction_requirements.data_integrity: Extract ACTUAL values only. Use null/empty for missing data. NEVER estimate or fabricate numbers.

individual_reports.overall_quality: PREMIUM PROFESSIONAL GRADE - equivalent to expensive consulting firm deliverable
individual_reports.content_depth: COMPREHENSIVE - Every section must be rich with detail. No generic placeholders. Show ALL extracted data.

visual_design.layout: Modern card-based responsive design. Gradient headers. Color-coded sections. Ample whitespace.
visual_design.typography: Clear hierarchy. Professional fonts. Readable sizes. Bold emphasis for key data.
visual_design.colors: Sophisticated palette. Color code by category (costs=emerald, events=coral, operations=azure, metrics=violet). Subtle shadows and borders.
visual_design.interactivity: Sortable tables. Expandable sections. Hover tooltips. Smooth CSS transitions.

data_visualizations.types: Mix of: bar charts (cost breakdown, activity distribution), pie charts (category percentages), timelines (events, operations), line charts (trends), gauge charts (KPIs vs targets)
data_visualizations.technology: Inline SVG with professional styling. Use gradients, shadows, animations. Each chart must have title, labels, legend, and data tooltips.
data_visualizations.quality: Publication-ready. Clear axes. Proper scaling. Color harmony. Professional legends.

required_sections: Executive Summary Dashboard (hero section with 6-8 metric cards showing key values with icons and trends)
Document Information (comprehensive table with ALL metadata fields)
Financial Analysis (detailed cost breakdown with multiple charts: total vs budget, daily vs cumulative, category pie chart, trend line)
Events Analysis (chronological table with ALL events, severity indicators, duration bars, timeline visualization)
Operations Log (hour-by-hour table with bilingual descriptions, activity type classification, inline mini-charts showing time distribution)
Key Performance Indicators (metric cards grid with comparisons and visual indicators)
Data Tables (ALL extracted tables rendered with professional styling and zebra striping)
Technical Details (equipment, personnel, safety notes in organized card layout)
Comparative Analytics (charts showing this report vs typical values)

content_quality.completeness: Display 100% of extracted data. No truncation. No 'see more' links.
content_quality.translations: Show BOTH languages side-by-side in tables. English on left, original on right.
content_quality.detail_level: MAXIMUM - Full event descriptions (not summaries). Complete operation notes. All table data.
content_quality.accuracy: Numbers must match JSON exactly. No rounding unless specified. Preserve units.

individual_reports.technical_requirements: Self-contained HTML (inline CSS, inline SVG charts, no external dependencies). Works offline. Clean semantic HTML5. Accessible markup.

master_index.overall_quality: EXECUTIVE DASHBOARD GRADE - C-suite presentation quality
master_index.content_depth: AGGREGATED INTELLIGENCE - Synthesize insights from all documents
master_index.layout: Three-panel dashboard: (1) Left sidebar navigation, (2) Main analytics area, (3) Right details panel
required_sections: Executive Overview (hero banner with total documents, date range, operators involved, total costs, total events, critical alerts)
Source Comparison (cards for each source showing: doc count, cost totals, event counts, avg metrics, quality indicator)

Consolidated Events & Costs Table (MASTER TABLE with ALL events from ALL documents - sortable by: date, operator, cost impact, severity, type. Columns: Date, Operator, Rig, Well, Event Type, Description (English), Duration, Cost Impact, Severity, Link to Detail Report. DEFAULT SORT: Cost Impact descending)
Cost Analytics Dashboard (multiple charts: total by operator, total by source, cumulative trend over time, category breakdown, daily rate comparison)
Events Analytics (charts: count by type, severity distribution, operator comparison, timeline gantt, duration histogram)
Operations Analytics (total hours by activity type, drilling vs NPT ratio, time efficiency comparison)
Performance Benchmarks (comparative metrics across documents: avg ROP, NPT percentage, cost efficiency)

interactivity.tables: Sortable by ANY column. Search/filter by text. Pagination (20 rows/page). Export to CSV button.
interactivity.charts: Hover tooltips with detailed data. Legend toggle to show/hide series. Responsive sizing.
interactivity.navigation: Click on any row to open detailed report. Breadcrumbs. Back to top button.

master_index.visual_quality: EXCEPTIONAL - Modern gradients, professional color scheme, subtle animations, polished typography, responsive layout (works on desktop and tablet).
master_index.technical_requirements: Self-contained. Inline CSS. Inline SVG charts OR Chart.js from CDN. Fast loading. Clean code.

quality_validation_task.description: MANDATORY QUALITY ASSURANCE: After master index generation, perform comprehensive quality check
validation_checks: Data Completeness: Verify master index aggregates data from ALL source documents (check counts match)
Visual Rendering: Open index.html in browser simulation and verify all charts render correctly
Table Functionality: Verify sortable table has ALL expected columns and ALL rows from source JSONs
Link Integrity: Verify ALL links to individual reports work (check file paths)
Cost Accuracy: Sum costs from all JSONs and verify matches master index total (tolerance: ±1%)
Event Count: Count events in all JSONs and verify matches master index count
Chart Data: Verify each chart pulls correct data (spot check 3 random data points per chart)
Translation Quality: Verify bilingual content shows both languages correctly
No Errors: Check browser console for JavaScript errors, check HTML validity
quality_validation_task.output: validation_report.json with pass/fail for each check and detailed findings
quality_validation_task.action_on_failure: If ANY check fails, report back to Boss with specific issues for correction

verification_requirements: STRICT: Every document must have: (1) Complete JSON with ALL schema fields populated (no empty arrays/objects for data that exists in PDF), (2) Premium HTML report matching quality standards, (3) All costs extracted with numbers and currency, (4) All events with English translations, (5) All charts rendering correctly. Master index must: (1) Aggregate ALL documents, (2) Sortable events/costs table with ALL entries, (3) All charts populated with real data, (4) Pass quality validation task.
additional_instructions:
**GENERAL WORKFLOW (Adapt to ANY document structure):**

**STEP 1 - UNPACK AND DISCOVER:**
Extract uploaded archive. Recursively scan for documents. Sample representative documents from each subdirectory/pattern. Identify: file types, languages, structural patterns (table layouts, header formats, cost field presence, event formats). Create dynamic grouping strategy.

**STEP 2 - BATCH EXTRACT BY PATTERN:**
For EACH discovered pattern:
- Use extract_multiple_pdfs with ALL documents in that pattern
- Pass this manifest's data_extraction_requirements as guidance for json_schema
- Add pattern-specific extraction notes based on discovery phase
- Emphasize: 'Extract EVERY field with MAXIMUM detail. Translate ALL non-English content. Use null only when data truly absent. Capture ALL numeric values with units.'
- Save: outputs/extracted/{pattern_name}/{document_basename}.json

**STEP 3 - GENERATE INDIVIDUAL REPORTS:**
For EACH extracted JSON:
- Create premium HTML report following html_report_quality_standards.individual_reports
- Generate inline SVG charts (minimum 5 per report): cost breakdown, events timeline, operations distribution, key metrics gauges, comparative analytics
- Implement bilingual content display (side-by-side or toggle)
- Use professional CSS with gradients, cards, hover effects
- Verify: Load JSON, inject into HTML template, render ALL charts, check completeness
- Save: outputs/reports/{source}/{document_basename}_report.html

**STEP 4 - CREATE MASTER INDEX:**
- Load ALL extracted JSONs (verify count matches total documents)
- Aggregate: Sum costs by operator/source/date, count events by type/severity, calculate totals
- Generate master index.html following html_report_quality_standards.master_index
- Build sortable events/costs table with ALL entries from ALL documents
- Create multiple aggregate charts (minimum 7 charts total)
- Implement table sorting, filtering, search functionality
- Add navigation links to individual reports
- Save: outputs/reports/index.html

**STEP 5 - QUALITY VALIDATION (MANDATORY):**
- Execute quality_validation_task checks
- Verify data completeness, visual rendering, functionality
- Generate validation_report.json
- If failures found: Report to Boss with specific issues
- If all pass: Declare success

**DATA EXTRACTION EMPHASIS:**
The pdf_extraction_schema defines the STRUCTURE of what to extract, but you must adapt field names/types to match actual document content. For costs: capture ALL financial data regardless of field name (daily rate, total cost, AFE, budget, etc.). For events: capture timing, description (translate!), severity, impact. For operations: capture activity, time, equipment, depth, description (translate!).

**HTML QUALITY EMPHASIS:**
Reports must look EXPENSIVE. Use modern web design principles: card-based layouts, color-coded sections, professional typography (system fonts: -apple-system, Segoe UI), smooth hover effects, gradient headers, subtle shadows, responsive grids. Charts must be BEAUTIFUL: smooth curves, gradient fills, professional legends, clear labels, proper scaling. This is NOT basic HTML - this is premium consulting deliverable quality.

**REMEMBER:**
- File paths: Use catalog lookup or filesystem search (rglob) - NEVER guess filenames
- Translations: ALWAYS provide both original and English - show side-by-side
- Charts: Inline SVG with professional styling - minimum 5 per individual report, 7 for master
- Tables: Sortable, searchable, properly formatted - show ALL data
- Validation: MANDATORY quality check before declaring success
- General approach: Adapt to ANY document structure - don't hardcode assumptions
